description: Fee billing on a wealth-management platform: billing runs and their failure codes, fee schedules and fee tiers, billable AUM and billing exclusions, invoices, fee adjustments and billing credits, billing periods and period close, household fee aggregation, custodian fee debits, client fee disputes, terminations and refunds, and who may approve what.

read_tools.get_billing_run_status: Returns the current status of one billing run by its run id: status, billing period, account count and failure reason.
read_tools.search_billing_runs: Lists the firm's billing runs, optionally filtered by status (pending, running, completed, failed) and billing period.

write_tools.propose_fee_adjustment: Proposes a change to one account's fee (a credit or an increase), for a person to confirm.

scope_summary.en: your firm's billing (fees, fee schedules, billing runs, fee adjustments)
scope_summary.bg: с таксуването на Вашата фирма (такси, тарифи, билинг цикли, корекции на такси)
